$description: Student Kare design tokens — the single source of truth for colour, type, space, shape, motion and interaction. W3C Design Tokens (DTCG) format: importable into Figma via Tokens Studio or a DTCG variables importer. Edit THIS file, then run `npm run tokens:build`. Never hand-edit the generated files.

surface-3.$description: Selected rows, icon tiles, info notes

rule-strong.$description: Outline of an interactive field or control. Darker than `rule` because WCAG 1.4.11 needs 3:1 for a UI component boundary, and a divider does not.

text-3.$description: Meta, captions, timestamps (minimum contrast for text)

brand-navy.$description: Brand navy (founder, 2026-10-20) — landing heroes, footers, dark panels, toasts. Same value as action, nav-bg, sidebar and hero-bg

sidebar.$description: Console sidebar (Super Admin, vendor and clinician shells) — brand navy

sidebar-active.$description: Current page fill on the sidebar: the white pill (founder, 2026-10-20). Its label and icon are on-nav-current (navy), never sidebar-ink

sidebar-ink.$description: Brand name and hovered link text on the sidebar. Not the current page: that label sits on the white pill in on-nav-current

action.$description: Primary buttons, links, selected state — brand navy

on-action.$description: Text/icons on action and status fills

focus.$description: Keyboard focus ring (3px, 3px offset). >= 3:1 on light surfaces AND on the navy (nav-bg, sidebar, brand-navy, hero-bg), and on the white nav pill (nav-current, sidebar-active), so one ring works everywhere

attention.$description: Needs attention, outside range, pending. Never red for a result.

danger.$description: Errors, destructive actions, mismatch, crisis links

clinical-value.$description: Lab values and vitals — always set in the mono font

neutral-bg.$description: Neutral status pills and tiles (not offered, ended, break)

on-danger-fill.$description: Text on danger-fill (count badges, danger buttons)

danger-rule.$description: Border of an error card or a danger-toned card

positive-rule.$description: Border of a positive pill that is also a control (availability)

selected-rule.$description: Border of the current item in a list (next consult). Always paired with a surface-3 fill, never the only cue

nav-bg.$description: Console sidebar (clinician, partner, campus, admin) — brand navy

nav-current.$description: Sidebar current page fill: the white pill on the navy (founder, 2026-10-20). Only for the selected item on a navy nav surface; never a light-surface accent, text, button or marker (use action)

on-nav-current.$description: Label and icon of the current item on the white pill (nav-current / sidebar-active): the navy

hero-bg.$description: Hero and feature panels (founder's navy, 2026-10-20). Stays dark in both schemes. Not a full-screen canvas

hero-bg-top.$description: Hero gradient start. Equal to hero-bg, so hero panels are flat navy; a lighter start needs its own contrast check

hero-current.$description: The only selected/current indicator allowed on a hero panel (a white pill). White pill + navy text is the selected state on every navy surface

on-hero-positive.$description: Positive pill text on the hero

on-hero-attention.$description: Amber text/icon on the navy (pending, needs attention). AA on hero-bg, brand-navy, nav-bg and sidebar

on-hero-veil.$description: Subtle translucent fill on the navy (chips, inset tiles). on-hero and on-hero-2 stay AA on it

on-hero-track.$description: Unfilled progress track on the navy; the filled part is on-hero (>= 3:1 against the track)

on-hero-rule.$description: Hairline divider on the navy. Decorative: never the only boundary of a control

on-action-2.$description: Muted secondary text on an action fill (button subtitle, price note). AA on action and action-hover

nav-danger.$description: Destructive link text on the navy sidebar (sign out). AA on nav-bg / sidebar / brand-navy

action-highlight.$description: Inset top highlight on primary buttons. Decorative

scrim-strong.$description: Blocking overlay (gate, full-screen dialog) where the page behind must not be read

chart-categorical-1.$description: Series 1 (navy family). Categorical marks: >= 3:1 on canvas and surface; spread in lightness so series stay apart under colour-vision deficiency. Use in order; beyond 4 series also label directly or vary marker shape

illustration-indigo-soft.$description: Landing/marketing illustrations only (never UI, text or status). Indigo family: soft tint

illustration-indigo-deep.$description: Illustration navy: the brand navy for shading and dark shapes

illustration-rose-deep.$description: Illustration rose shading. Not danger: never for errors or alerts

illustration-ink.$description: Dark outline and detail ink in illustrations

illustration-ink-light.$description: Light line ink in illustrations drawn on the navy

illustration-highlight.$description: Specular highlight / white shapes in illustrations

art-tint-1.$description: Product/category art tint (indigo). Decorative fills in marketplace product art and category tiles; never text or status

decor-1.$description: Celebration accent (confetti) gold. Decorative only, aria-hidden; never on a health result (DESIGN.md §2)

paper.$description: Paper prescription sheet. Stays paper-light in dark mode (a picture of a physical document; dark ink on light paper is what a pharmacist checks against)

paper-rule.$description: Border and divider on the paper sheet. Decorative

paper-ink.$description: Handwriting and doctor name on the paper sheet. AA on paper in both schemes

paper-ink-2.$description: Printed meta on the paper sheet. AA on paper in both schemes

qr-foreground.$description: QR code modules. Never inverts in dark mode (Tier 1 review: inverted QR is a scan risk)

qr-background.$description: QR code quiet zone and background. Never inverts in dark mode

camera-bg.$description: Camera viewfinder and face-capture frame. Stays dark in both schemes (a live camera feed is dark; a light frame would glare round it)

camera-accent.$description: Viewfinder reticle corners, laser line and detection boxes on camera-bg. Fixed in both schemes; >= 3:1 on camera-bg

on-camera.$description: Hint text and the shutter ring on camera-bg. Fixed in both schemes; AA on camera-bg

brand-navy-light.$description: Lighter navy for the top of navy gradients (Mobile 2.0 primary buttons, pill nav, chat bubbles, hero cards); the bottom stays brand-navy. Same in both schemes; on-hero is AA on it

ayush-orb-glint.$description: Cyan glint at the top-left of the Ask Ayush orb (radial: ayush-orb-glint, service-indigo, brand-navy-light). Decorative only

service-indigo.$description: Mobile 2.0 service palette, indigo light stop (For You tile, upload tiles); the indigo set uses brand-navy as deep, surface-3 as soft and action as ink. Gradient light stops are decorative: never put text or the only icon contrast on them

service-violet.$description: Mobile 2.0 service palette (violet: lab tests): gradient light stop of the glossy service tile, top-left. Decorative; white glyphs and text sit on the deep end

service-violet-deep.$description: Service palette violet: gradient deep stop; on-hero (white) glyphs and text are AA on it. Same in both schemes (the tiles stay vivid on the dark canvas)

service-violet-soft.$description: Service palette violet: soft tile background (concern/category tiles, row icon tiles, product art). Muted deep tone in dark

service-violet-ink.$description: Service palette violet: icon and short text on service-violet-soft (AA). Light tint in dark

service-violet-shade.$description: Service palette violet: dark end of a hero or card gradient that carries white text (service-violet-deep → service-violet-shade, founder 2026-10-21: no white text on a light stop). on-hero is AA on both. Same in both schemes

service-blue.$description: Mobile 2.0 service palette (blue: consults, diabetes): gradient light stop of the glossy service tile, top-left. Decorative; white glyphs and text sit on the deep end

service-blue-deep.$description: Service palette blue: gradient deep stop; on-hero (white) glyphs and text are AA on it. Same in both schemes (the tiles stay vivid on the dark canvas)

service-blue-soft.$description: Service palette blue: soft tile background (concern/category tiles, row icon tiles, product art). Muted deep tone in dark

service-blue-ink.$description: Service palette blue: icon and short text on service-blue-soft (AA). Light tint in dark

service-sky.$description: Mobile 2.0 service palette (sky: campus, cold and cough): gradient light stop of the glossy service tile, top-left. Decorative; white glyphs and text sit on the deep end

service-sky-deep.$description: Service palette sky: gradient deep stop; on-hero (white) glyphs and text are AA on it. Same in both schemes (the tiles stay vivid on the dark canvas)

service-sky-ink.$description: Service palette sky: icon and short text on service-sky-soft (AA). Light tint in dark

service-teal.$description: Mobile 2.0 service palette (teal: medicines, eye care): gradient light stop of the glossy service tile, top-left. Decorative; white glyphs and text sit on the deep end

service-teal-deep.$description: Service palette teal: gradient deep stop; on-hero (white) glyphs and text are AA on it. Same in both schemes (the tiles stay vivid on the dark canvas)

service-green-deep.$description: Service palette green: gradient deep stop; on-hero (white) glyphs and text are AA on it. Same in both schemes (the tiles stay vivid on the dark canvas)

service-green-soft.$description: Service palette green: soft tile background (concern/category tiles, row icon tiles, product art). Muted deep tone in dark

service-green-ink.$description: Service palette green: icon and short text on service-green-soft (AA). Light tint in dark

service-green-shade.$description: Service palette green: dark end of a hero or card gradient that carries white text (service-green-deep → service-green-shade, founder 2026-10-21: no white text on a light stop). on-hero is AA on both. Same in both schemes

service-amber.$description: Mobile 2.0 service palette (amber: vaccines, vitamins): gradient light stop of the glossy service tile, top-left. Decorative; white glyphs and text sit on the deep end

service-amber-deep.$description: Service palette amber: gradient deep stop; on-hero (white) glyphs and text are AA on it. Same in both schemes (the tiles stay vivid on the dark canvas)

service-rose.$description: Mobile 2.0 service palette (rose: skin care, sexual health, vaccines card): gradient light stop of the glossy service tile, top-left. Decorative; white glyphs and text sit on the deep end

focus.$description: Dark focus ring: >= 3:1 on every dark surface, on the navy AND on the white nav pill (#A5B4FC was 2.0:1 on the pill)

on-action-2.$description: Dark action is light, so its muted text is translucent dark ink

scrim.$description: Darker than light-mode scrim so a sheet separates from the already-dark canvas

illustration-indigo-soft.$description: Dark: soft tints become muted deep tones so large fills do not glare on the dark canvas

illustration-highlight.$description: Dimmed white so highlights do not glare on the dark canvas

paper.$description: Still paper-light in dark mode, dimmed a little so the sheet does not glare

contrast-minimum.$description: WCAG 2.1 AA minimum contrast ratios, named once. contrast-pairs refer to them by name; tests read them from skTokens.contrastMinimum.

text.$description: Body text and icons that carry meaning (WCAG 1.4.3)

non-text.$description: Large text, UI components, focus and selected indicators (WCAG 1.4.3 large text, 1.4.11)

contrast-pairs.$description: Every text/background pair used in the product, with the contrast-minimum it must meet. The token test fails if any pair drops below it.

sans.$description: All UI text. Telugu and Devanagari glyphs fall through to the Noto faces (DESIGN.md §3).

serif.$description: Only the italic ‘Kare’ in the wordmark

mono.$description: Clinical values, codes, IDs, times in logs

eyebrow.$description: Small uppercase section labels: caption size, weight 800, letter-spacing 1px, colour text-2

sheet.$description: Bottom sheets and drawers (top corners only)

touch-target.$description: Minimum hit area for anything tappable (AGENTS.md rule 7)

nav-icon.$description: Line icons in the phone tab bar (canvas HomeDiscover bottom bar)

phone-frame-max.$description: Widest web viewport that draws the phone boards' frame (phone header and student tab bar) instead of the desktop web shell

desktop-min.$description: Narrowest content width (not viewport) that lays Mobile 2.0 pieces out on the desktop grid (useM2Layout: phone up to phone-frame-max, tablet between, desktop from here)

panel-max.$description: Widest a single-column account or settings panel grows on the web

anim-inline.$description: Animated icon inside a button, toast tile or chip (AnimatedIcon size="inline")

anim-icon.$description: Animated icon on the 24 px grid: nav, rows (AnimatedIcon size="icon")

anim-mark.$description: Animated state mark and loader (AnimatedIcon size="mark")

anim-tile.$description: Animated 3D tile, same as the <Icon3d> default (AnimatedIcon size="tile")

anim-scene-sm.$description: Animated illustration in a card or empty state (AnimatedIllustration size="sm"; the width, height follows the art)

anim-scene.$description: Animated illustration as a section's art (AnimatedIllustration size="md")

anim-scene-lg.$description: Animated illustration as a hero (AnimatedIllustration size="lg")

hairline.$description: The small lift under chips, pills, small buttons and rows (any shadow with under 12px blur). Not a boundary: pair with a rule border where the edge matters

toast.$description: How long a confirming toast stays before it dismisses itself. Errors and warnings never auto-dismiss (board Feedback)

spinner-delay.$description: A spinner appears only after this, so a quick action never flashes one (board Feedback)

carousel.$description: Mobile 2.0 highlight carousel: how long each highlight shows before the next. Stops under reduced motion, while hovered or focused, off-screen, and for good once the student picks a dot

ambient.$description: One cycle of a slow decorative loop on Mobile 2.0 (tile shine, floating art, live dot). Never on clinical content; off under reduced motion and when unmounted

orbit.$description: One turn of the Ayush orb's spark in the pill nav; off under reduced motion

rule.$description: All motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion. Never animate or celebrate anything about the body (no confetti on results, vitals or diagnoses).
